author: ThioJoe
description:
I couldn't believe I wasted money on the wrong batteries before...

Do you have a bunch of rechargeable batteries thinking they'll be more convenient, but when you actually need to use them they're always dead? I figured out they are not all created equal. In fact there's basically only one good brand/manufacturer of them. Most brands of rechargeables self discharge so fast you need to charge them when you use them anyway, and they also have a limited lifespan anyway. So I go over what I learned, and the right one to buy that solves all this.
